name: swarm
description: Install and configure Zedbee Swarm hooks and CI, scan proposed changes, apply built-in autofixes, and diagnose problems. Opt into agent-assisted repairs with --agent-fix.

interface.longDescription: Set up Zedbee Swarm in your repository for pre-commit and CI checks. Scan proposed changes, apply built-in autofixes, opt into agent-assisted repairs, or diagnose installation and check failures.
defaultPrompt: Set up Swarm with a pre-commit hook and CI in this repository.
Scan my proposed changes with Swarm.
Use Swarm to scan and fix my changes, including agent-assisted repairs.
